w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Mateo. Buffering, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 Night. The lingering Ad Break gorges at the treeline — 1,000 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🛖 A week of sharpened stakes and lashed crossbeams, and Haven has a wall — a real one, shoulder-high, with a walkway and a watch. The village sleeps differently tonight. Lighter.

◈ SYSTEM: "The long game, little hoarders. A GRANARY. Stockpile 20,000 kcal, 500 wood and 2,000 kcal of PRESERVED food — food that WAITS. Smoke it, dry it, render it. The audience finds delayed gratification EXOTIC. So do stomachs, we are told."
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
★ IDENTIFIED: Gum Acacia. Thorny tree, amber tears on the bark. The gum is food. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Identification complete. You are 0.3% less lost.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (18/10/4), with 5 wave-4 fought, 7 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 5 · Craft 1 · Talk 13 · Explore 31 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.

gotAwayLines: It got away — but the dead don't run. You take what's theirs.
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,188 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
